name: Skill Generator
description: Generate a reusable SKILL.md document from meeting transcripts.

sections.title: Skill Name
sections.instruction: Infer a concise lowercase-hyphenated skill name (example: deploy-staging-server). Must only use [a-z0-9-].

sections.title: Description
sections.instruction: Write one sentence describing what this skill does and when it should be used.

sections.title: When To Use
sections.instruction: List trigger situations and suitability conditions from the transcript. If unclear, use [Missing from transcript].

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.instruction: List required tools, environment setup, permissions, or dependencies. If missing, use [Missing from transcript].

sections.title: Steps
sections.instruction: List numbered execution steps. Include concrete commands only when explicitly present in the transcript. If command details are missing, mark as [Command missing in transcript].

sections.title: Pitfalls & Gotchas
sections.instruction: List common mistakes, caveats, and failure modes discussed. If no details are present, use [Missing from transcript].

sections.title: Verification
sections.instruction: List checks that confirm correct execution. Use observable outcomes from transcript when available; otherwise use [Verification detail missing in transcript].
